title: Vector Store Implementations
summary: This module defines the abstract interface for vector stores and provides concrete implementations for in-memory storage and integration with the Qdrant vector database. It enables adding, deleting, and searching documents based on their vector embeddings.

nodes.label: VectorStore
nodes.title: Base Vector Store Interface
nodes.description: Defines the abstract interface for all vector store implementations, providing methods for adding, deleting, and searching documents based on vector embeddings.

nodes.label: InMemoryVectorStore
nodes.title: In-Memory Vector Store
nodes.description: A concrete implementation of VectorStore that stores and manages vector embeddings and documents entirely in local memory, using NumPy for similarity calculations.

nodes.label: QdrantVectorStore
nodes.title: Qdrant Vector Store (New API)
nodes.description: Integrates with the Qdrant vector database, supporting dense, sparse, and hybrid retrieval modes for efficient storage and search of vector embeddings using the new Qdrant API.

nodes.label: Qdrant (Classic API)
nodes.title: Qdrant Vector Store (Classic API)
nodes.description: An older or alternative integration with the Qdrant vector database, providing core functionalities for adding, deleting, and searching documents using the classic Qdrant API.

nodes.label: Embeddings
nodes.title: Embedding Generation
nodes.description: An external component responsible for converting text into numerical vector representations (embeddings).

nodes.label: SparseEmbeddings
nodes.title: Sparse Embedding Generation
nodes.description: An external component specifically for generating sparse vector embeddings, used in hybrid retrieval modes by QdrantVectorStore.

nodes.label: QdrantClient
nodes.title: Qdrant Database Client
nodes.description: The official client library for interacting with the Qdrant vector database, handling connection and API calls.

nodes.label: Document
nodes.title: Document Data Structure
nodes.description: Represents a piece of text content along with associated metadata, used for storage and retrieval in vector stores.

nodes.label: VectorStoreRetriever
nodes.title: Vector Store Retriever
nodes.description: A component that wraps a VectorStore to provide a standard retrieval interface, allowing for various search types and configurations.

groups.label: Vector Store Core
groups.title: Core Vector Store Interface
groups.description: The foundational abstract class defining the contract for all vector store implementations.

groups.label: In-Memory Storage
groups.title: In-Memory Vector Storage
groups.description: A lightweight, in-memory implementation of a vector store for local data management.

groups.label: Qdrant Integrations
groups.title: Qdrant Database Integrations
groups.description: Implementations for interacting with the Qdrant vector database, supporting various retrieval strategies.

groups.label: External Dependencies
groups.title: External Components and Data
groups.description: Components and data structures from other modules or external libraries that are utilized by the vector stores.
